document.about: Cree Lighting CR4T downlight spec sheet, Canada (Word-made, 3 pages). Its field angle sets the degree sign as a small raised letter o after the number.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#200): the coefficients of utilization are headed by the ceiling's and the walls' reflectances, `RC %: | 80` over `RW %: | 70 | 50 | 30 | 10`, over rows keyed by the room cavity ratio. Read as data, no value was named by the reflectances it is for.

2026-11-25 (#270): the average-luminance table's title band runs over every column but the narrow one `Vertical Angle` is turned in, whose rule runs up through the band. Read as no band across the table, the title was every value's column header.

checks.issue: #270: the average-luminance title band named every column.
#270: under its title, `Horizontal Angle` over `0° | 45° | 90°` heads the luminance values; the angles were read as a row of data and no value had a column header.
